scope: Conditional survey-wide comparison for initial search/automatic-triage survivors at sealed b003; not the selected 60 dossiers

null_controls.survivor_definition: Any automatic-triage survivor on a host; vetting errors count as survivors

comparison.interpretation: If the null controls represent the real survey background, roughly one third of initial survivors could be noise/stellar-variability false alarms before eclipsing binaries. The upper endpoint cannot rule out most or all.
limits: Transfer from finite transformed controls to the real population is an assumption, not established exchangeability.
The rate ratio is a conditional population comparison, not a calibrated individual false-alarm probability or astrophysical FPP.
It is not a measured contamination fraction for the 60 dossiers selected after further vetting.
Eclipsing binaries, blends and other astrophysical contaminants require separate assessment.
The live run can change after the sealed b003 snapshot; these are dated rates.
